evidence: Crude charge pump 11-PM-01A/B discharges the crude to the preheat exchanger 11-E-01.
The preheated crude from 11-E-01 enters the desalter 11-V-02.
Desalted crude from 11-V-02 flows to the pre-flash drum 11-V-10.
Pre-flash drum 11-V-10 bottoms are pumped to the atmospheric heater 11-F-01.
The heater 11-F-01 outlet feeds the atmospheric column 11-C-01 flash zone.
11-PG-101 indicates the crude charge pump discharge pressure.
11-FRC-101 controls the crude charge flow by throttling the crude charge pump discharge.
